items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: And Chris Kelly too. I remember all them old fellas.

ctx.x: Chris Kelly. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Buddy Manaday, Joe Watson, Yang Johnson. And old Kid Punch. All them old fellas. Sam Bowman. And just drink with the song. Guy A. Butler rap is his name. But Punch doesn't drink anymore. He can.

No, he better quit. He can. Before I left here and he was staying in all them big markets and clothing store on Saturday night out on the balcony. He drank like a fish. Punch did. And Chris Kelly too. I remember all them old fellas.
My stomach is bad, too. I remember all of them. That's right. Stuck, too.
